summary: Audit Phase 1 (frontend only, web preview 390x844 + 320x700, QA learner 7004186276). Verified: Dream College Goal pin/unpin, 5-per-exam limit (6th refused with message, BITSAT/COMEDK separate limits), Rank Dream panel (line, exam switch, meter sorted by need, remove updates counts everywhere), Home DreamMeter (empty state -> Rank college tool, 3 rows + 'Sab N dream dekho' -> Rank with panel open, 'K aur dream jodo'), persistence across reload, Result screen DreamMeter (IS MOCK MEIN 5/300, gaps = need-5), Home/Rank LAST MOCK after visiting result; College predictor open form blood red (border rgba(255,59,78,.75), Show #D10F2A) and collapsed bar = purple gradient #B43CFF->#6A16E8 + white light-sweep with blood-red Edit pill 79x44 + hint, for JEE/BITSAT/COMEDK, tap reopens form; PDF + card photo: with stubbed navigator.canShare/share, rank-pdf / bitsat-pdf / comedk-pdf / rank-shortlist-pdf WhatsApp each share 2 files (image/png JEELIVE-Rank-Card.png 94-155 KB + application/pdf) with caption and success line; desktop fallback (no canShare) downloads PDF + opens api.whatsapp.com and shows the download message; plain rank-pdf downloads PDF. No red screens / page errors (only the expected 401 from /api/jl/auth/refresh before login). FOUND 2 HIGH bugs: (1) dream data loss when the result screen is the first screen that loads the dream store (cold open / refresh / deep link to /result/:id) - stored dreams are overwritten with []; (2) chapter tests with maximum >= 150 (Coordination Compounds 0/200) are treated as full JEE mocks - result-dream shown, scaled 0/300 and recorded as LAST MOCK. Plus several MEDIUM/LOW issues (target-marks vs card inconsistency, truncation at 320/390, small touch targets, silent refusal on concurrent pins, dreams not scoped per account). No deprecated Expo packages found in package.json.

ui_bugs.issue: HIGH - DATA LOSS. If the dream store has not been loaded yet when recordMock() runs (open /result/<id> directly: page refresh, deep link, notification, web URL), the child DreamMeter starts async load() and then the parent's recordMock effect calls save({dreams: [], mocks:[mock]}) which writes dream.v1 with NO dreams. load() then merges the old dreams into memory only, so the screen still shows them, but after the next reload all pinned dreams are gone. Repro: seed 2 dreams -> goto /result/4ff8dce7-... -> localStorage dream.v1 has 0 dreams, 1 mock; reload Home -> 0/5. Warm path (Home first, then in-app nav to result) keeps dreams. Reference: /app/frontend/src/dream/store.ts:26 (save) + :29-38 (load) + :71-77 (recordMock); /app/frontend/app/result/[id].tsx:326-330

HIGH - chapter tests counted as full mocks. Rule 'maximum >= FULL/2' lets a 50-question chapter test (Coordination Compounds, 0/200, exam 'JEE Main') through: result-dream is shown ('0/200 ko 300 par scale kiya'), and it is recorded as a mock -> becomes Home/Rank 'LAST MOCK', distorts gaps and the 'pichhle mock se' delta. Use the paper type / question count / full-paper flag (e.g. 75 Q for JEE Main, 130 for BITSAT, 180 for COMEDK) instead of max marks. Reference: /app/frontend/src/dream/store.ts:71-73, /app/frontend/app/result/[id].tsx:62-64. Repro: My Tests -> Completed -> attempt 952adf58-7270-4e2a-add7-25ab00733152

LOW - with 4/5 JEE dreams, tapping two DREAM buttons quickly pins the first; the second build finishes, toggleDream returns 'full' and NO message is shown (silent no-op). Limit itself holds (stored 5). Reference: /app/frontend/src/dream/useDreamToggle.ts:24-27

LOW - DreamPanel always opens on JEE Main (useState 'jee'); a student with only BITSAT/COMEDK dreams opens the panel and sees an empty JEE meter. Default to the exam of the latest mock / first exam with dreams (like HomeDream). Reference: /app/frontend/src/dream/DreamPanel.tsx:18

LOW (code review) - rank.tsx only scrolls to top for tool=college; for tool=dream the panel is opened but, if the Rank tab was already mounted and scrolled down, the opened panel stays off-screen. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/rank.tsx:86

integration_issues.issue: MEDIUM - dream 'need' uses Target-marks row.final = JoSAA final round (R5) closing, while the College predictor card that was pinned shows the CSAB round closing where the seat was found. Example at 180 marks: IIIT Lucknow IT card says 'Borderline, CSAB 2 closing 14,859' but the dream says 'Target 188 · R5 closing 11,235' => student at 180 is told he is 8 marks away from a seat the card says he gets. All 5 pinned 'Borderline' seats at 180 showed need 188-192. Either compute the need from the card's own round/closing, or label it clearly ('JoSAA final round ke liye'). Reference: /app/frontend/src/dream/need.ts:16-23

MEDIUM - dream.v1 (dreams + mock scores) is device-global and not cleared on sign-out (auth.tsx signOut clears jl_user, assets, RF access only). critical_code_review_comments: store.ts: load() sets loaded=true then awaits storage; save() can run in between and persist an empty dreams array (confirmed data loss).
store.ts recordMock: maximum-based full-mock rule is too loose (200-mark chapter tests pass for JEE).
need.ts: JEE profile (category/gender/state) captured at pin time; dreams are never recomputed if the student changes category later.
DreamMeter with mockId: if the mock was not recorded (e.g. only revised version loaded), the result shows 'Pehla full mock do' on a full mock result.
No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch) in package.json.

rca_of_issue: Data loss: DreamMeter (child) effect calls load() (async) before Result's parent effect calls recordMock(); recordMock -> save() persists {dreams: [], mocks:[m]} since in-memory state is still empty; load() then merges stored dreams into memory but never re-saves, so storage keeps the empty list. Mitigation: await a single load promise in save/recordMock/toggle, or re-save after merge in load().
